{{Youmay|the rank held by [[Followers of Palawa]]|[[Steel Hand (disambiguation)|another use of the term]]}}
{{Quote|After my investment as a Steel Hand of Palawa, I journeyed to Pelgrin to learn my fortune from the Oracle.|[[Arden Lyn]] to [[Laddinare Torbin]], [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]|<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Steel Hand of Palawa''' was a title or rank held by members of the [[Followers of Palawa]],<ref name="Palawa">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] says that [[Arden Lyn]] was a [[Followers of Palawa|Follower of Palawa]] and on page 16 of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', Arden Lyn claims to have been a Steel Hand of Palawa.</ref> a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] sect found on [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> According to a debriefing overseen by [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Laddinare Torbin]] in [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], [[Arden Lyn]]<ref name="TEGtW" />&mdash;a Follower of Palawa and leader of the [[Legions of Lettow]]<ref name="JvS" />&mdash;claimed to have held this title prior to her visit to [[Pelgrin]] to learn of her future from the [[The Oracle (Pelgrin)|Oracle]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
